notes.title: Multiplayer co-op Beta is Live!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29013586/7ffc4baa52a83c8be96d9f15c3a39df6340be667.jpg[/img]

[h1]Hello guys![/h1]

I'm super excited to finally be able to release something we've been working for the couple months, after a bunch of hours (and loooooots of coffee) in order to make the game networkable and stuff, the co-op is finally in a state we are comfortable to call a[b] Beta [/b].

You can access the Beta directly from your library by right-clicking the game and under the beta tab and opt in the beta branch.

All feedback is well appreciated and we will continue improving this to give you guys a fun game to play with your friends!.

Enjoy and escape together the lost islands!.

notes.title: Patch Notes v.1.0.3
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29013586/ef69f8384853836e7af00d832588703c1ccafae5.jpg[/img]
[h1][b]General[/b][/h1]
									[list]									[*]Hunger system completely revamped, it should now be a significant mechanic, losing importance at higher levels[/*]									[*]Reworked the leveling system, particularly the progression on the recoil and reload time was erratic, and the max ammo was reaching absurd values. Also adapted to the new hunger system. [/*]
									[*][i][b]IMPORTANT NOTICE:[/b] If you already have a save, your save will be updated to the new leveling system whenever you load your checkpoint. You will retain your level and experience but with the stats from the new system, as a result, the weapon upgrades will be reset and your goldcubes will be refunded, but you can always go back to the shop and upgrade them again. This will only happen once on the first load. We're sorry for the inconvenience this might cause. If this is your first time playing this won't affect you. [/i][/*]									 [/list]									 [h1][b]User Interface[/b][/h1]
 									[list]									[*]Added Scrollbars to recipes and weapons lists. [/*]									[*]Added Notifications when leveling with information about the level reached and stats gained[/*]									[/list] 									[h1][b]Enemies[/b][/h1]
									[list] 									[u][b]King of Island Kings[/b][/u]
									[*]General difficulty increased, All boss "stages" have now increased Health Points.[/*]									[*]Added a second stage for the Final Boss after defeating his first form.[/*]                                      [*]Final boss will now spawn powerful minions from other worlds.[/*]
                                    [*][i]Please continue giving us feedback so we can make the experience of playing more enjoyable.[/i][/*]								    [/list]

notes.title: v.1.0.1 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h1][b]General[/b][/h1]
[list][*]Chests and missions now get reset on game completion [/*][*]Increased gold cubes despawn timeout from 15 to 60 seconds. [/*][*]Increased the radius the player uses to collect items from 1.4 to 2 meters [/*][*]Fixed a bug where players could get stuck trying to collect a recipe scroll [/*][*]Fixed the store bug which wouldn't show the correct amount of gold[/*] [/list] [h1][b]User Interface [/b][/h1]
[list][*]Text Notifications now scale correctly with different resolutions. [/*][/list] [h1][b]Levels[/b][/h1]
[u][b]General[/b][/u] 
[u]Traps[/u] [list][*]Axe pendulum and saw trap now only cause 70 damage on impact, down from instakill [/*][*]Spike trap damage lowered [/*][*]Stomp trap and fire trap unchanged [/*][/list] [u][b]Jurassic level[/b][/u]
 [list][*]Checkpoints updated [/*][*]Increased thickness of a doorway's navigation mesh obstacle [/*][*]Put one door sound in the mixer [/*][*]Made invisible colliders ignore raycast [/*][*]Removed underwater fog in "magic" pond in cliffs for better visibility [/*][/list] [h1][b]Weapons[/b][/h1]
[list] [*]Upgraded bows with projectile count, they now shoot all the arrows with the same force. [/*][*]Fixed some instances where assigning weapons to slots wasn't saving properly.[/*]								[/list]

notes.title: Block Survival Release update!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29013586/7974a23587874a00411af2d0d6920e32be05be13.jpg[/img]

[b]Hello guys!, Thanks for your feedback and all your support![/b]
We will have the game ready for you on [b]July 2017[/b] with new and improved features based on your input of our demo!

We are moving forward with all the [b]bug fixes, game polishing, optimization, balancing, and some other additions[/b] to the game that will make it better and more exciting.

We are super excited to see [b]all your feedback, not only in our social media but also from the videos you've uploaded to your channels[/b] [i](yes we've seen all of them and joined as ninjas to some of your twitch streams as well mwahaha).[/i]

Also we finished some [b]achievements and steam cards[/b] for the collector inside you!

Please follow us also in our [b]social media[/b] to stay in touch and get the [b]latests news, contests and updates.[/b]

See you guys soon in the lost islands.

Cheers!.

[b]Raion.[/b]
